native_sharing_probe.mechanism: CreateFileW directory handle with GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ|FILE_SHARE_WRITE and no FILE_SHARE_DELETE
native_sharing_probe.scope: Controlled native directory-sharing denial; does not identify the original clean-extraction denial's cause

retained_development_observation.initial_native_probe_setup: A READ_ATTRIBUTES-only directory handle did not deny rename; the test assertion failed once while the other six tests passed.
retained_development_observation.correction: Used GENERIC_READ to establish a real conflicting share mode; the corrected native test and all refusal tests passed.
retained_development_observation.interpretation: This was a test setup correction, not evidence that the original publication failure's holder was identified.
